summary: Several studies have directly applied transformer-based models to the task of mapping active wildfire extent. Adebayo et al. (2026) [V0173] used self-attention encoder models on the FireScope dataset, achieving an AUROC of 0.85. Brennan et al. (2018) [V0174] compared baselines with self-attention encoder models on ChurnBench, reporting an F1 score of 0.92. Chen et al. (2019) [V0175] proposed a system using self-attention encoder models, evaluated on MetroFlow with an accuracy of 0.64. Duarte et al. (2020) [V0176] reported results from Atlas-ICU, obtaining an MAE of 0.71. El-Sayed et al. (2021) [V0186] studied mapping active wildfire extent using multilevel probabilistic models with partial pooling on ChurnBench, reporting an AUROC of 0.9.
